hook_text: Parts on the bench, iron in its stand, drawings on the wall. Here is how a model gets built without a single surprise.
clip_script: Lay every part beside its number and tick the list. Pin up the three drawings. Box first, while it is empty: mark from the drawing, start small, drill to size. Then the board: polarity checked, tip on lead and pad for two seconds, solder to the joint, pull away, hold still. Bright and smooth, good; dull and lumpy, do it again. Cut the strip board tracks the diagram needs. Test the board before it goes in. Fit the holder, the board, the lid parts with slack. Close, label. Then test every specification, outside if the brief says outside, and write pass or fail. Glasses on throughout.
visual_style: Whiteboard bench layout with numbered parts; a drill on an empty lid; a close-up solder joint forming; a track cut; a tick list of specifications with one fail and a fix arrow.
pacing: Lay out, drawings, box, solder, cut, test board, fit, close, test specs, safety.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and practise three solder joints on scrap board before touching your real one.
